title: Colleague
summary: COLLEAGUE, noun A partner or associate in the same office, employment or commission, civil or ecclesiastical. It is never used of partners in trade or manufactures. COLLEAGUE, verb transitive To unite

inlines.v: COLLEAGUE, noun A partner or associate in the same office, employment or commission, civil or ecclesiastical. It is never used of partners in trade or manufactures. COLLEAGUE, verb transitive To unite with in the same office.
